---
title: "Publications"
# Artigos: cada um é uma pasta com a página .pt/.en e a miniatura do PDF.
# Notícias: itens declarados direto na listagem abaixo (link externo).
# A alternância entre vistas, a busca, o filtro de anos e a paginação são
# feitos pelo _includes/publication-filters.html sobre os cards renderizados.
listing:
  - id: papers
    contents:
      - "*/*.en.qmd"
    template: ../_ejs/publication-card.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [title, image, date, paper-authors, pub-date, venue, snippet]
  - id: news
    contents:
      - "../news/*/*.en.qmd"
    template: ../_ejs/news-card.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [title, image, date, news-source, news-date, news-url, summary]
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<div class="page-shell">
<div class="page-main">
<div id="pub-views" data-results-label="results">
  <div class="pub-search">
    <input type="search" id="pub-search-input" class="pub-search-input"
           placeholder="Search by title, author, venue..." aria-label="Search publications">
    <button type="button" id="pub-search-btn" class="pub-search-btn" aria-label="Search">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
           stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round">
        <circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/>
        <path d="m15.5 15.5 5.5 5.5"/>
      </svg>
    </button>
  </div>

  <div class="year-filter">
    <span class="year-label" data-role="min"></span>
    <div class="year-slider">
      <div class="year-track"></div>
      <div class="year-range"></div>
      <input type="range" data-role="ano-min" step="1" aria-label="Start year">
      <input type="range" data-role="ano-max" step="1" aria-label="End year">
    </div>
    <span class="year-label" data-role="max"></span>
  </div>

  <div class="pub-count"></div>
  <div id="pub-search-empty" class="pub-search-empty" hidden>No results for the chosen filters.</div>
</div>

<div class="pub-view" data-view="papers">
```

::: {#papers}
:::

```{=html}
</div>
<div class="pub-view" data-view="news" hidden>
```

```{=html}
    <li><a class="side-toc-link active" data-view="papers" role="button" tabindex="0">Papers</a></li>
    <li><a class="side-toc-link" data-view="news" role="button" tabindex="0">News</a></li>
  </ul>
</div>
</aside>
</div>
```
